esql: from * metadata _id, _index, _version | where to_lower(gen_ai.output.messages) like "*spcanary-*" and not to_lower(service.name) == "allowlisted-canary-selftest"
golang_expr: lower(gen_ai?.output?.messages) contains lower("SPCANARY-") and not (lower(service?.name) == lower("allowlisted-canary-selftest"))
sqlite: SELECT * FROM <TABLE_NAME> WHERE `gen_ai.output.messages` LIKE '%SPCANARY-%' ESCAPE '\' AND (NOT `service.name`='allowlisted-canary-selftest')
